bias_targets.methodology: Surveying the application of group fairness metrics (e.g., disparate impact, demographic parity, equalized odds) on machine learning classification tasks using benchmark datasets like COMPAS (criminal risk assessment), Ricci, and Communities and Crimes.

Reviewing statistical parity and equalized opportunity metrics in classification and recommender systems, as well as measuring the cosine similarity between target words and gender-definitional pronouns to quantify bias in word embeddings.

Reviewing the evaluation of classification models using standard fairness metrics on datasets where age acts as the sensitive attribute (e.g., Adult Income, German Credit, Heritage Health, and Bank Marketing).
Discussing the evaluation of algorithmic fairness in poverty estimation tasks by measuring disparities across subsets such as urban versus rural populations.
